slides.texte_overlay:
Moments when staying quiet
makes you stronger

1.
Stay quiet when you don't
have the full story yet.

2.
Stay quiet when someone
is finally opening up.

3.
Stay quiet when the boss
is already angry. Talk tomorrow.

4.
Stay quiet when the topic
is new to you. Listen, then
learn it properly.
slides.texte_sophia:
4.
Stay quiet when the topic is new.
Listen, then learn it on
the Sophia app that night.

slides.texte_overlay:
5.
Stay quiet when you're tired.
Tired words leave scars.

6.
Stay quiet about your plans
until they're done.

7.
Stay quiet when a stranger
wants to argue online.

8.
Stay quiet when you won.
Let others say it.
